data.reasoning: Both models agree the PKGBUILD is safe, containing standard build instructions with pinned sources and valid checksums. The disagreement was solely due to a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen3 model when auditing the .SRCINFO file, which is non-executable metadata. The deepseek model successfully audited .SRCINFO and found it safe.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen3 model encountered an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when attempting to audit .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive file verdict that escalated to an inconclusive package verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited .SRCINFO and marked it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the critical executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and found safe. The tool should either retry the request or gracefully degrade the impact of metadata file failures on the final verdict.
